pricing.notes: No /pricing page (404). Product markets free chat/app and MCP tools for domain research under a hard maxBudgetUsd. Powered by DomainDiscovery research infrastructure. Not a registrar; human confirms purchase.

verdictSummary: A weekend agent can wire an LLM name generator plus a few TLD checks and a budget filter. Production MCP tools, honest price confidence flags, live availability research, and a public Agent Card are multi-day productization on top of domain data infrastructure.
coreLoopDIY: Take a business brief and maxBudgetUsd, generate candidate domains, check availability for a small TLD set, score brand fit, return a ranked shortlist with within/over/unknown budget flags.
requirements: DomainDiscovery-class data path or DIY APIs
whatYouLose: MCP-native tool catalog and Agent Card discovery
budget discipline with honest unknown pricing
polished human app + agent dual surface
guardrails against auto-buy and invented fees
moatNotes: agent protocol surface + domain research infra; not a registrar network
whyPeopleStillPay: If it stays free for research, people use it to skip building MCP + budget ranking. If premium tiers appear later, they pay for reliability of agent tools and research quality · not for a registrar checkout they already have elsewhere.

prompt:
Build an AI domain research assistant (Node or Python). Requirements:

- Input: business brief text + maxBudgetUsd (e.g. 20).
- Pipeline: parse brief → generate 30 name ideas (LLM) → append TLDs (.com .io .ai) →
  availability check (RDAP or free API) → score brand fit (length, keywords) →
  filter by budget if price known else mark unknown → return ranked JSON shortlist.
- Expose one HTTP POST /find_brand_domains and a minimal MCP-style tool description JSON.
- Never invent registration prices; use within | over | unknown.
- No auto-buy. Print registrar link only.
- README + example curl.

Out of scope: real registrar checkout, DNS mutations, 1600 TLDs, payments.

Ship a runnable service in one folder.
